## Why visit

The strongest anchor for a St Helens excursion: a distinctive turreted Tudor-revival pub with a serious rotating cask range, real cider, food and a thriving community role. The local CAMRA branch awarded it both Pub and Cider Pub of the Year in 2026. Upstairs tastings and other events show a deeper interest in beer than a long tap list alone, although none should be assumed for your dates. Pair it with the Cricketers rather than stretching the outing across several towns. This is a place to settle into and explore the day’s range.

## Beer

CAMRA’s October 2026 record describes fourteen rotating cask handpulls; current beers and the number pouring should be checked. Recent CAMRA cask sightings include Thornbridge Old Badequella and Imperial Stout; the large guest selection remains rotational.

## Plan the visit

Card/electronic payments only. Check actual tasting dates and which room suits quiet conversation; sport is shown in the bar area. Selected among CAMRA’s final four national Pub of the Year contenders for 2026 (winner announced in 2027).

**Getting there:** A walk or local connection from St Helens Central; combine with the Cricketers Arms as a separate excursion.
